chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 581: The Convergence – Zhuge Yuan’s Return & Dragon Vein War
chapter_meta_description: The Dice unleashes the Dragon Vein army against Li Huowang. Zhuge Yuan returns for one final stand. Bai Lingmiao descends with a transformed White Lotus cult. The convergence begins.
og_title: The Convergence — Every Ally & Enemy Collides in Chapter 581
og_description: Li Huowang’s skull splits, Zhuge Yuan returns with a spine-sword, and Bai Lingmiao’s White Lotus disciples descend as the Dragon Vein fractures.
twitter_title: Ch 581: The Convergence – Zhuge Yuan is BACK and it HURTS
twitter_description: The Dice tears off dragon scales, the sky breaks, and Li Huowang eats eyeballs for power. This chapter is absolutely unhinged.

lore_anchors.definition: In this novel, the Dragon Vein is a physical chain of corpse-emperors that holds up the celestial mandate; it is a stolen fragment of power that can only be sustained by a family willing to commit self-slaughter.
A classical Chinese imperial title claiming divine rule; the Dice weaponizes this to command military families bound by ancestral oaths.
An ancient Chinese military formation; here used tactically to surround a reality-warper with disciplined, coordinated soldiers immune to his powers.
A weapon made from a mythical beast’s spine; Zhuge Yuan wields one as his signature self-sacrificial tool.
A Daoist ritual weapon strung with old coins; Danyangzi wields one in this chapter, reinforcing the link between corrupt Daoist practice and the temple he came from.
In this chapter, they appear bare-chested with cheek-piercing talismans and white donkey tattoos, marking a transformation from folk sect to militant spirit-medium war cult.
